# PhysioReport

Clinical report generation for the
[x-biosignal](https://github.com/x-biosignal) ecosystem: parameterized,
bilingual (JA/EN), colorblind-safe reports (gait, HRV, EMG) with
normative overlays and MDC/MCID-annotated change.

## Installation

``` r

install.packages("PhysioReport",
  repos = c("https://x-biosignal.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
```

Part of the x-biosignal rehabilitation-standard implementation plan.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`NormativeModel()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/NormativeModel.md)
  : Normative reference model (mean / SD corridor)
- [`annotateChange()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/annotateChange.md)
  : Classify pre-to-post change against MDC and MCID thresholds
- [`as.timelineData()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/as.timelineData.md)
  : Adapt a longitudinal tracker to timeline data
- [`buildDocxReport()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/buildDocxReport.md)
  : Build an editable DOCX clinical report (officer)
- [`clinicalGaitReport()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/clinicalGaitReport.md)
  : Clinical gait report dashboard
- [`gaitIndexDashboard()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/gaitIndexDashboard.md)
  : Gait index dashboard panel (GDI / GPS / MAP)
- [`longitudinalTimeline()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/longitudinalTimeline.md)
  : Longitudinal patient timeline (swimlane)
- [`normativeZScore()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/normativeZScore.md)
  : Normative z-score of an observation
- [`physioLabel()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/physioLabel.md)
  : Bilingual (Japanese / English) label lookup for reports
- [`plotBlandAltman()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/plotBlandAltman.md)
  : Bland-Altman agreement plot
- [`plotChangeAnnotated()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/plotChangeAnnotated.md)
  : Forest-style plot of annotated pre-to-post changes
- [`plotNormativeBand()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/plotNormativeBand.md)
  : Plot an observation against a normative band
- [`plotOutcomeRadar()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/plotOutcomeRadar.md)
  : Multi-domain outcome radar (spider) plot
- [`plotSCED()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/plotSCED.md)
  : Single-case (SCED) plot with phase overlays
- [`renderClinicalReport()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/renderClinicalReport.md)
  : Render a parameterized clinical report (PDF / DOCX / HTML)
- [`reportTheme()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/reportTheme.md)
  : The x-biosignal report theme
- [`scedStats()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioReport/reference/scedStats.md)
  : Single-case (SCED) effect-size summary
